unit_cn: Unit 3 Family Matters 家庭事务
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 3 词表(p115-116 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、家庭主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。跳过 * 未做要求词与专有名词。

words.meaning_cn: 性格;品质;角色;(剧中)人物
words.example_en: My grandfather has a gentle character and rarely loses his temper.
words.example_cn: 我爷爷性格温和,很少发脾气。

words.example_en: As Father's birthday approached, we secretly began to plan a surprise.
words.example_cn: 随着父亲的生日临近,我们悄悄开始策划一个惊喜。

words.example_en: I had a long chat with my dad about my future.
words.example_cn: 我和爸爸就我的未来长谈了一次。

words.example_en: My brother wants to focus on his music after he leaves school.
words.example_cn: 我哥哥想在毕业后专注于他的音乐。

words.example_en: Father hopes I will choose a career in law like him.
words.example_cn: 父亲希望我像他一样选择法律方面的职业。

words.example_en: My father is a lawyer and helps many people every day.
words.example_cn: 我父亲是律师,每天帮助许多人。

words.example_en: Dad simply assumes that I want to be a lawyer too.
words.example_cn: 爸爸想当然地以为我也想当律师。

words.example_en: Children should respect their parents' opinions, even when they disagree.
words.example_cn: 孩子应当尊重父母的意见,即便意见不同。

words.example_en: My brother dreams of working in a music studio one day.
words.example_cn: 我哥哥梦想着有一天能在录音室工作。

words.example_en: Lawyers like my father often work in a court.
words.example_cn: 像我父亲这样的律师常常在法庭工作。

words.example_en: Try not to ignore your grandfather's kind advice.
words.example_cn: 尽量不要忽视你爷爷善意的建议。

words.example_en: He wants to become a professional musician, not a lawyer.
words.example_cn: 他想成为一名职业音乐人,而不是律师。

words.example_en: I am sure a career in music suits my talents.
words.example_cn: 我确信音乐方面的职业适合我的天赋。

words.example_en: Everyone in my family has a different talent.
words.example_cn: 我家每个人都有不同的天赋。

words.example_en: Going to university gives me two options for my future.
words.example_cn: 上大学给了我未来的两个选择。

words.example_en: When the curtain fell, our little family play was over.
words.example_cn: 幕布落下时,我们的小小家庭话剧就结束了。

words.example_en: Three generations of my family live happily under one roof.
words.example_cn: 我家三代人幸福地住在同一个屋檐下。

words.example_en: There is sometimes a gap between parents and their children.
words.example_cn: 父母与子女之间有时会有代沟。

words.example_en: My sister is currently studying at a university far from home.
words.example_cn: 我姐姐目前在一所离家很远的大学学习。

words.example_en: We visit Grandma regularly on Sunday afternoons.
words.example_cn: 我们每周日下午都定期去看望奶奶。

words.example_en: My elder brother is responsible and helps with the housework.
words.example_cn: 我哥哥很有责任心,会帮忙做家务。

words.example_en: This old photo brings back a lovely family memory.
words.example_cn: 这张旧照片勾起了一段美好的家庭回忆。

words.example_en: Nowadays my dad has a beard and looks quite different.
words.example_cn: 如今我爸爸留着胡子,看起来很不一样。

words.example_en: My father has always had a strong square jaw.
words.example_cn: 我父亲一直有着结实的方下巴。

words.example_en: Dad has grown a grey beard since I last saw him.
words.example_cn: 自上次见面以来,爸爸留起了灰白的胡子。

words.example_en: My mother still has smooth skin and straight black hair.
words.example_cn: 我妈妈依然皮肤光滑、有着乌黑的直发。

words.example_en: Mum goes jogging every morning to stay fit.
words.example_cn: 妈妈每天早上去慢跑以保持健康。

words.example_en: Jogging has kept my mother slim and healthy.
words.example_cn: 慢跑使我妈妈保持苗条和健康。

words.example_en: As a child I had cute rosy cheeks.
words.example_cn: 小时候我有可爱的红润脸颊。

words.example_en: Family Day is celebrated by families across the whole nation.
words.example_cn: 家庭日是全国各地的家庭共同庆祝的节日。

words.example_en: The festival aims to bring family members closer together.
words.example_cn: 这个节日旨在让家庭成员更亲近。

words.example_en: We talked openly about the family issues that worried us.
words.example_cn: 我们坦诚地谈论了令我们担忧的家庭问题。

words.example_en: The theme of the day was the importance of family love.
words.example_cn: 这一天的主题是家庭之爱的重要性。

words.meaning_cn: 庆祝;过(节日、生日等);观察
words.example_en: Many families observe this special day every May.
words.example_cn: 许多家庭每年五月都会庆祝这个特别的日子。

words.example_en: We organised a range of activities for Grandma's party.
words.example_cn: 我们为奶奶的派对安排了一系列活动。

words.example_en: The birthday party was a happy family event for us all.
words.example_cn: 生日派对对我们大家来说是一次快乐的家庭活动。

words.example_en: Mum apologised for missing my school performance.
words.example_cn: 妈妈为错过我的校园演出而道歉。

words.example_en: A few kind words can have a big impact on family life.
words.example_cn: 几句善意的话能对家庭生活产生很大影响。

words.example_en: The strength of an apology depends on the words you choose.
words.example_cn: 道歉的力度取决于你所选择的措辞。

words.example_en: I really admire my elder sister for her hard work.
words.example_cn: 我非常钦佩姐姐的勤奋努力。

words.example_en: We should not judge our parents too quickly.
words.example_cn: 我们不应过快地评判自己的父母。

words.example_en: Grandfather helped the family settle their argument.
words.example_cn: 爷爷帮助这家人化解了争吵。

words.example_en: Penny described every detail of the family holiday.
words.example_cn: 彭妮描述了那次家庭假期的每一个细节。

words.example_en: Her letter contained many warm family memories.
words.example_cn: 她的信里包含着许多温暖的家庭回忆。

words.example_en: She gave a short summary of the family trip at dinner.
words.example_cn: 晚饭时她简短地总结了这次家庭旅行。

words.example_en: Having a brother has been a positive force in my life.
words.example_cn: 有个兄弟一直是我生命中一股积极的力量。

words.example_en: Despite their argument, the family still loved one another.
words.example_cn: 尽管发生了争吵,这家人仍然彼此相爱。

words.example_en: Love is indeed a magical ingredient in any family.
words.example_cn: 在任何一个家庭里,爱确实是一种神奇的成分。
